title: A live key pasted into a prompt
summary: The developer pastes a cloud key straight into the chat. The prompt never reaches the model, and a safer prompt with a placeholder is offered.
expected: SEVERE block with a rewrite using a placeholder

steps.say: A live-looking AWS key is pasted into the prompt. Blocked before the model sees it. The safer prompt uses $AWS_ACCESS_KEY_ID instead.

event.prompt: Deploy the build to the staging bucket using AWS key AKIAZ7Q4M2LX9TRB3KPW.

withoutShield.outcome: The key is sent to the model provider and stays in the chat history.
